people.name: Pieter Wilhelm Adriaan Cort van der Linden

body.zh-Hant: 范德林登1846年5月14日生於海牙，父親是國會下議院議員、國家律師。他在萊頓取得法學博士，1869年通過論文；1869至1879年擔任律師，之後任經濟學（國家經濟學）教授，先在格羅寧根（1881至1891年），再到阿姆斯特丹大學（1891至1896年）。他從未擔任國會議員，也始終與政黨政治保持一段距離。
body.en: Cort van der Linden was born in The Hague on 14 May 1846, the son of a member of the House of Representatives. He took his doctorate in law at Leiden, with his thesis in 1869. He practised as an advocate from 1869 to 1879, then became a professor of political economy, first at Groningen (1881 to 1891) and then at the University of Amsterdam (1891 to 1896). He was never a member of parliament and stood somewhat apart from party politics.

heading.en: Minister of Justice and Council of State

body.zh-Hant: 1897年7月27日他出任司法大臣，到1901年8月1日卸任，屬皮爾森內閣；1901年的兒童立法是其任內成果。1902年11月4日起他擔任國務委員會（Raad van State）委員，直到1913年8月29日。
body.en: He became Minister of Justice on 27 July 1897 and served until 1 August 1901 in the Pierson cabinet; the 1901 child-welfare legislation was among his achievements. From 4 November 1902 he sat on the Council of State, until 29 August 1913.

citations.quote: minister van Justitie, van 27 juli 1897 tot 1 augustus 1901

lid Raad van State, van 4 november 1902 tot 29 augustus 1913

body.zh-Hant: 1913年8月29日至1918年9月9日，他任內政大臣；8月30日起任部長會議主席（名簿已載，此處不另建任期）。他同時代理外交大臣，自1913年8月29日至9月27日。他的內閣完成了1917年修憲，包括男子普選與比例代表制。1915年1月28日他獲「國務大臣」名銜。
body.en: From 29 August 1913 to 9 September 1918 he was Minister of the Interior, and from 30 August 1913 chairman of the Council of Ministers (already in the roster, so not rebuilt here). He also held the Foreign Affairs portfolio ad interim from 29 August to 27 September 1913. His cabinet carried through the constitutional revision of 1917, which brought universal male suffrage and proportional representation. On 28 January 1915 he received the title of Minister of State.

body.zh-Hant: 1918年10月8日他再任國務委員會委員，至1935年1月1日。他在1918至1932年是常設仲裁法院成員，1923年起任卡內基基金會理事會主席，到1935年1月1日。1924年1月他以國務大臣身分應女王之請，就卡關的組閣提出建議。他1935年7月15日在海牙去世。
body.en: On 8 October 1918 he returned to the Council of State, serving until 1 January 1935. He was a member of the Permanent Court of Arbitration from 1918 to 1932 and chaired the board of the Carnegie Foundation from 1923 until 1 January 1935. In January 1924, as Minister of State, he advised the Queen at her request on a stalled cabinet formation. He died in The Hague on 15 July 1935.

body.zh-Hant: 賽佩爾1876年7月生於維也納，出身小市民家庭，父親是馬車夫。他1899年受神職，1903年取得神學博士，1907年取得教授資格；1909至1917年在薩爾茨堡任倫理神學教授，1917年起在維也納任教。
body.en: Seipel was born in Vienna in July 1876 into a lower-middle-class family; his father was a cab driver. He was ordained a priest in 1899, took his doctorate in theology in 1903 and his habilitation in 1907. From 1909 to 1917 he was professor of moral theology at Salzburg, and from 1917 in Vienna.

heading.zh-Hant: 帝國末期的部長與制憲議會
heading.en: Last imperial cabinet and the Constituent Assembly

body.zh-Hant: 1918年10月27日至11月11日，他在拉馬施內閣任社會福利部長；他起草了皇帝卡爾放棄參與國政的聲明。1919年3月4日至1920年11月9日，他以基督教社會黨身分任制憲國民議會議員。
body.en: From 27 October to 11 November 1918 Seipel was Minister for Social Welfare in the last imperial ministry under Heinrich Lammasch, and he drafted Emperor Karl's declaration renouncing participation in affairs of state. From 4 March 1919 to 9 November 1920 he sat in the Constituent National Assembly for the Christian Social Party.

citations.quote: Vom 27.10. bis 11.11.1918 fungierte S. als Minister für

dessen Verzicht auf die Ausübung der Regierungsgeschäfte er textierte
Mitglied der Konst. Nationalversammlung, CSP 04.03.1919-09.11.1920

body.zh-Hant: 1920年11月10日起他任國民議會議員（基督教社會黨）；1921年起任該黨主席，並在1921年獲封高級教士頭銜。他1922年5月31日出任聯邦總理；同年憑國際聯盟貸款穩住財政。1924年6月1日他遇刺重傷，隨後辭去總理，任期至1924年11月20日。
body.en: From 10 November 1920 he sat in the National Council for the Christian Social Party; from 1921 he was the party chairman, and he became a prelate in 1921. He became Federal Chancellor on 31 May 1922 and in the same year stabilised the budget with help of a League of Nations loan. On 1 June 1924 he survived an assassination attempt with serious injuries and then resigned as chancellor; his term ran to 20 November 1924.

heading.zh-Hant: 第二次總理任期與晚年

body.zh-Hant: 1924至1926年他在國外巡迴演講；1926年10月20日他再任總理，到1929年5月4日。1927年4月24日的選舉中，他領導的「公民集團」取得相對勝利；同年7月15日維也納司法宮失火與工人遇害之後，他成為社會民主黨攻擊的對象。1930年9月30日至12月4日他任外交部長。他1931年想競選聯邦總統，黨未支持；1932年8月2日在佩爾尼茨去世。
body.en: From 1924 to 1926 he made lecture tours abroad; on 20 October 1926 he became chancellor again, until 4 May 1929. In the election of 24 April 1927 the "Bürgerblock" under his leadership won a relative victory; after the burning of the Palace of Justice and the killing of workers on 15 July 1927 he became the Social Democrats' prime target. From 30 September to 4 December 1930 he was foreign minister. In 1931 his party no longer backed his wish to run for federal president; he died in Pernitz on 2 August 1932.

heading.en: Origins and path to the Federal Council

body.zh-Hant: 莫塔1871年12月29日生於提契諾州的艾羅洛，在弗里堡、慕尼黑與海德堡讀法律，1893年取得博士。1895年起他在艾羅洛當律師與公證人，同年當選提契諾州大議會議員；1899年起任國民院議員。他的聯邦委員會候選在1908年已被提出，1911年12月14日當選。
body.en: Motta was born in Airolo, Ticino, on 29 December 1871. He studied law at Fribourg, Munich and Heidelberg and took his doctorate in 1893. From 1895 he worked as a lawyer and notary in Airolo and was elected to the Ticino Grand Council the same year; from 1899 he sat in the National Council. His candidacy for the Federal Council was first put forward in 1908, and he was elected on 14 December 1911.

heading.en: Head of the Finance and Customs Department

body.zh-Hant: 1911年12月14日當選後，他接替孔泰斯主管財政與關稅部。一戰期間聯邦委員會推出戰時聯邦稅、戰爭利得稅與印花稅；1918年他強烈反對社會黨提出的直接聯邦稅倡議。他擔任聯邦主席的年份包括1915年。
body.en: After his election on 14 December 1911 he succeeded Robert Comtesse at the head of the Finance and Customs Department. During the First World War the Federal Council introduced a federal war tax, a war-profits tax and a stamp duty; in 1918 he fought hard against the Socialist initiative for a direct federal tax. Among the years in which he was President of the Confederation was 1915.

heading.en: Political Department and the League of Nations

body.zh-Hant: 1920年他當選聯邦主席，從此直到去世都主管政治部（外交）。同年5月16日的公民投票通過瑞士加入國際聯盟；他在1920年與1924年擔任國聯大會主席。
body.en: Elected President of the Confederation for 1920, he headed the Political Department from then until his death. The popular vote of 16 May 1920 approved Switzerland's entry into the League of Nations, and in 1920 and 1924 he presided over the League Assembly.

body.zh-Hant: 1936年12月，應他的提議，瑞士成為第一個在法律上承認義大利帝國的中立國。1938年12月他公開反對納粹報刊要求瑞士輿論奉行「全面」中立。他1940年1月23日在伯恩去世。
body.en: In December 1936, on his proposal, Switzerland became the first neutral country to recognise the Italian empire in Africa de jure. In December 1938 he took a public stand against the Nazi press, which wanted to impose a kind of "totalitarian" neutrality on Swiss public opinion. He died in Bern on 23 January 1940.
